raw:
@a1 assumed
  relation "play"
  role subject "Dua Lipa"
  role location "Budapest"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  select ?t
  where match
    relation "play"
    role subject "Dua Lipa"
    role location "Budapest"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end
